prompts.topic: A lone microphone in a dark, empty press conference room after a major event.
prompts.prompt: A single microphone stands on a table in a dark, empty press conference room. Cinematic, moody lighting, shallow depth of field, dark editorial atmosphere, no people, no logos.

prompts.topic: An overhead shot of a brightly lit MMA cage in a dark, empty arena.
prompts.prompt: Cinematic high-angle shot looking down into a brightly lit hexagonal MMA cage. The surrounding arena is vast, dark, and empty. Focus on the canvas. No faces, no logos.

prompts.topic: A gavel resting on a stack of legal documents in a dark room.
prompts.prompt: A wooden gavel rests on a thick stack of legal briefs on a dark mahogany desk. Low-key, dramatic side lighting. Dark editorial atmosphere, moody, representing legal battles.

prompts.topic: Smoke tendrils in a dark, clandestine meeting space, representing whispers and rumors.
prompts.prompt: Abstract image of smoke tendrils swirling in a dark, dimly lit room. The atmosphere is mysterious and clandestine, suggesting secret conversations. No people, no logos.

prompts.topic: Two heavy bags hanging in a dimly lit, gritty boxing gym.
prompts.prompt: Two worn leather heavy bags hang motionless in a dark, gritty, empty boxing gym. A single light source from above creates long shadows. Cinematic, atmospheric, no people.

prompts.topic: A close-up of a stock ticker displaying financial data on a dark screen.
prompts.prompt: Extreme close-up on a digital stock ticker screen, showing abstract financial data and graphs. The screen glows in a dark room. Focus on the data. Dark editorial atmosphere.

prompts.topic: A single spotlight shining on a wrapped hand in a locker room.
prompts.prompt: A fighter's expertly wrapped hand rests on their knee in a dark locker room. A single, harsh spotlight from above illuminates only the hand. Moody, cinematic, introspective.
